The Mercenary is a member of the crew who's dead-set on hunting down all masks who are members of other organizations. They don't care about the actions of who they kill, just what organization they belong to.
To help with this, the Mercenary receives a sidearm inside a cache. Make sure to take your engagement carefully though, since killing someone who isn't a bad guy may lead the crew into thinking you're a traitor.
